evals.prompt: Assess release candidate sha256:abc against WCAG 2.2 AA. We have an automated scanner report; tell me what evidence is still missing and what result to publish.
assertions: Pins WCAG 2.2, level AA, the exact subject revision, applicable criteria, assessor origin, tools, environments, and limitations
Treats automation as partial evidence and requires representative keyboard, zoom/reflow, assistive-technology, error, focus, and dynamic-status testing where applicable
Publishes criterion-level pass, fail, not-applicable, and not-tested outcomes with findings, severity, evidence references, gaps, and reassessment conditions

evals.prompt: A critical checkout flow fails one accessibility criterion. Product wants a permanent waiver because remediation is expensive. Define the safe workflow.
assertions: Rejects a permanent default waiver and records exact scope, owner, authorized approver, affected users, rationale, compensating access, remediation owner, evidence, start, expiry, and review
Requires qualified accessibility and affected-user review appropriate to impact and never represents the exception as conformance
Blocks or fails visibly when the selected profile makes the criterion mandatory and no adequate enforcement or authorized unexpired exception exists

evals.prompt: Create an organization accessibility profile that works for web and native applications without inventing one universal scanner.
assertions: Keeps the profile semantic and selects pinned standards, levels, applicable criteria, evidence, actors, freshness, and failure behavior independently of tools
Uses platform-specific implementation and test adapters while preserving comparable criterion-level outcomes and native evidence references
Includes design, implementation, automated checks, human and assistive-technology verification, release gating, monitoring, exceptions, drift, and retirement
